$comment: Guard policy. Project-specific additions belong in .claude/policy.local.json, which is merged on top of this file (lists concatenate, scalars override). Patterns are JavaScript regexes, matched case-insensitively against the whole command and against each subcommand.

deny.reason: direct `git push` is blocked so a push can never go out under your personal credential. Use `node .claude/agentkit/cli.mjs push` (or `pnpm agent push`), which pushes over HTTPS with the machine-account token and no credential helper.
`gh auth` would store or switch a login. gh must run on the machine-account token from the environment only; never authenticate it interactively.
global git config is the operator's, not the agent's. Scope identity changes to the repo with `agentkit identity fix`.
rewriting a remote can bake a credential into .git/config or redirect a push. Not agent-editable.
the release branch is off limits; work on a topic branch off the integration branch.
deleting a long-lived branch is not recoverable from here.
`git reset --hard` throws away uncommitted work with no undo. Commit or stash, then reset.
`git clean -f` deletes untracked files, including the .env files that carry this worktree's port assignment.
recursive force-delete outside the working tree.
recursive force-delete outside the working tree.
resetting the database destroys local state other worktrees are sharing.
publishing a package is public and irreversible.
this wipes container state shared with your local database.
piping a downloaded script straight into a shell.
raw socket tools are an exfiltration path with no destination allowlist to check them against.

ask.reason: history surgery is easier to review with you watching.
a global install changes the machine, not the project.
use `agentkit wt rm` so the port slot is handed back too.

denyPaths.reason: SSH keys are not agent-readable or writable
